ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat/ALPHV double-extortion exfiltration via rclone/Exmatter to public cloud storage
ucs.description: Hunts for the rclone-based staged exfiltration pattern that ALPHV/BlackCat (also tracked as Noberus / CrowdStrike's affiliate ecosystem behind Exbyte/Exmatter) uses prior to encryption — `rclone copy` with high-throughput flags pushing data to MEGA, S3, or WebDAV before T1486 detonates. This is one of BlackCat's most consistent tradecraft fingerprints across victim reporting.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="rclone.exe" OR Processes.original_file_name="rclone.exe" OR Processes.process="*rclone*") AND Processes.process IN ("*copy*","*sync*","*move*") AND Processes.process IN ("*mega:*","*--webdav-url*","*--s3-*","*b2:*","*drive:*","*dropbox:*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(lower(cmdlines),"(--config|--no-check-certificate|--multi-thread-streams|--transfers\s+\d{2,}|--ignore-existing|--auto-confirm)") AND NOT match(user,"(?i)(svc-backup|veeam|cohesity)") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
// BlackCat / ALPHV rclone-based exfil to cloud — Exbyte / Exmatter tradecraft
let RcloneFlags = dynamic(["--config","--no-check-certificate","--multi-thread-streams","--transfers","--ignore-existing","--auto-confirm","--progress"]);
let CloudRemotes = dynamic(["mega:","webdav:","drive:","dropbox:","s3:","b2:","ftp:","sftp:","azureblob:"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where FileName =~ "rclone.exe"
   or ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName =~ "rclone.exe"
   or ProcessVersionInfoProductName has "rclone"
   or (ProcessCommandLine has_any (RcloneFlags) and ProcessCommandLine has_any (CloudRemotes))
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("copy","sync","move","copyto")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (CloudRemotes)
| extend RenamedRclone = iff(FileName !~ "rclone.exe" and ProcessVersionInfoOriginalFileName =~ "rclone.exe", true, false)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, RenamedRclone,
          ProcessCommandLine, FolderPath, SHA256,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

let CloudRemotes = dynamic(["mega:","webdav:","drive:","dropbox:","s3:","b2:","ftp:","sftp:","azureblob:"]);

| where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("copy","sync","move","copyto")
| where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any (CloudRemotes)
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, TargetProcessName,
          TargetProcessCommandLine, ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: BlackCat ALPHV rclone Exfiltration to Cloud Storage
id: 7b2c3d4e-9f1a-4d22-b1c1-blackcat-rclone-001
status: experimental
description: Detects rclone usage with cloud-remote targets and high-throughput flags consistent with BlackCat / ALPHV / Noberus pre-encryption data theft via Exmatter / Exbyte tradecraft.
references:
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2022/06/13/the-many-lives-of-blackcat-ransomware/
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/alphv-ransomware-affiliates
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
  - attack.exfiltration
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.t1048
  - threat.blackcat
  - threat.alphv
  - threat.noberus
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    - Image|endswith: '\rclone.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'rclone.exe'
  selection_verb:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' copy '
      - ' sync '
      - ' move '
      - ' copyto '
  selection_remote:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'mega:'
      - 'webdav:'
      - 'drive:'
      - 'dropbox:'
      - 's3:'
      - 'b2:'
      - 'ftp:'
      - 'sftp:'
      - 'azureblob:'
  filter_legit:
    User|contains:
      - 'svc-backup'
      - 'veeam'
  condition: (selection_image or selection_remote) and selection_verb and selection_remote and not filter_legit
falsepositives:
  - Sanctioned backup/sync jobs using rclone
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) (@Image:(*\rclone.exe OR *\RClone.exe OR *\RCLONE.EXE) OR (@CommandLine:(*--config* OR *--no-check-certificate* OR *--multi-thread-streams* OR *--ignore-existing*) AND @CommandLine:(*mega\:* OR *webdav\:* OR *drive\:* OR *dropbox\:* OR *s3\:* OR *b2\:* OR *ftp\:*))) AND @CommandLine:(*copy* OR *sync* OR *move*) AND -@User:(*svc-backup* OR *veeam*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\rclone\.exe$/i OR regex("(--config|--no-check-certificate|--multi-thread-streams|--transfers\s+\d{2,}|--ignore-existing)", field=CommandLine)
| regex("(?i)\s(copy|sync|move|copyto)\s", field=CommandLine)
| regex("(?i)(mega:|webdav:|drive:|dropbox:|s3:|b2:|ftp:|sftp:|azureblob:)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT regex("(?i)(svc-backup|veeam|cohesity)", field=UserName)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen), collect([CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName, SHA256HashData], multival=true)])
ucs.rationale: BlackCat/ALPHV affiliates have repeatedly shipped a customized rclone (and the bespoke Exmatter/Exbyte stager built around it) as the exfil step in their double-extortion playbook. The cloud-remote prefixes (mega:, webdav:, dropbox:) combined with rclone's batch flags are a much narrower signal than a generic T1567.002 detection — they specifically map to the Noberus affiliate kit. ucs.title: [LLM] BlackCat/ALPHV pre-encryption sabotage chain: VSS deletion + recovery disable + backup-service kill
ucs.description: Hunts the tight pre-detonation sequence ALPHV/BlackCat (Noberus) runs on every victim host: vssadmin/wmic shadow-copy wipe, bcdedit recovery-disable, and a taskkill/net-stop sweep targeting Veeam, MSSQL, BackupExec, and Memtas — typically pushed from a compromised DC via PsExec or the Rust loader's embedded `--child` mode. The combination on one host inside a 10-minute window is near-pathognomonic for this actor right before T1486.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdlines values(Processes.process_name) as procs values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","sc.exe","taskkill.exe","powershell.exe","cmd.exe") AND Processes.process IN ("*delete shadows*","*shadowcopy delete*","*shadowcopy call delete*","*recoveryenabled No*","*bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures*","*wbadmin delete catalog*","*stop veeam*","*stop MSSQL*","*stop SQLSERVERAGENT*","*BackupExecAgent*","*/im sqlservr.exe*","*/im veeam*","*Memtas*","*stop \"vss\"*") by Processes.dest Processes.user _time span=10m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval techniques=case(match(cmdlines,"(?i)(delete shadows|shadowcopy delete|shadowcopy call delete)"),"vss_wipe", match(cmdlines,"(?i)(recoveryenabled No|bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures|wbadmin delete catalog)"),"recovery_disable", match(cmdlines,"(?i)(stop veeam|stop MSSQL|stop SQLSERVERAGENT|BackupExecAgent|/im sqlservr|/im veeam|Memtas)"),"backup_kill") | stats dc(techniques) as technique_count values(techniques) as techniques values(cmdlines) as observed_cmds values(procs) as observed_procs min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime by dest user | where technique_count >= 2 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
// BlackCat / ALPHV pre-encryption sabotage chain (VSS + recovery + backup-services)
let Window = 10m;
let Sabotage = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where FileName in~ ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","sc.exe","taskkill.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe")
    | extend Tech = case(
        ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","shadowcopy delete","shadowcopy call delete","Win32_ShadowCopy"), "vss_wipe",
        ProcessCommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled No","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures","wbadmin delete catalog","delete catalog -quiet"), "recovery_disable",
        ProcessCommandLine has_any ("stop \"vss\"","stop veeam","stop MSSQL","stop SQLSERVERAGENT","BackupExecAgent","/im sqlservr.exe","/im veeam","Memtas","stop \"Backup"), "backup_kill",
        "")
    | where Tech != ""
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, Tech,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession;
Sabotage
| summarize TechCount = dcount(Tech),
            Techniques = make_set(Tech),
            Procs      = make_set(FileName, 10),
            Cmds       = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
            Parents    = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5),
            RemoteSpawn = max(tobool(IsInitiatingProcessRemoteSession)),
            FirstSeen  = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen   = max(Timestamp)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, Window)
| where TechCount >= 2   // 2/3 of the BlackCat sabotage triad in <=10 min
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// BlackCat / ALPHV pre-encryption sabotage chain on Sentinel (SecurityEvent 4688)
let Window = 10m;
let Sabotage = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
    | extend BinName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where BinName in ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","sc.exe","taskkill.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe")
    | extend Tech = case(
        CommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","shadowcopy delete","shadowcopy call delete","Win32_ShadowCopy"), "vss_wipe",
        CommandLine has_any ("recoveryenabled No","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures","wbadmin delete catalog","delete catalog -quiet"), "recovery_disable",
        CommandLine has_any ("stop \"vss\"","stop veeam","stop MSSQL","stop SQLSERVERAGENT","BackupExecAgent","/im sqlservr.exe","/im veeam","Memtas"), "backup_kill",
        "")
    | where Tech != ""
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, TargetUserName, BinName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, Tech;
Sabotage
| summarize TechCount = dcount(Tech),
            Techniques = make_set(Tech),
            Procs      = make_set(BinName, 10),
            Cmds       = make_set(CommandLine, 10),
            Parents    = make_set(ParentProcessName, 5),
            FirstSeen  = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen   = max(TimeGenerated)
            by Computer, TargetUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, Window)
| where TechCount >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) (@Image:(*\vssadmin.exe OR *\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\wmic.exe OR *\WMIC.exe OR *\bcdedit.exe OR *\BCDEdit.exe OR *\wbadmin.exe OR *\net.exe OR *\net1.exe OR *\taskkill.exe OR *\TaskKill.exe OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe)) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"shadowcopy delete"* OR *"shadowcopy call delete"* OR *"recoveryenabled No"* OR *"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"* OR *"wbadmin delete catalog"* OR *"stop veeam"* OR *"stop MSSQL"* OR *"stop SQLSERVERAGENT"* OR *BackupExecAgent* OR */im sqlservr.exe* OR */im veeam* OR *Memtas*) AND -@TargetUserName:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(vssadmin|wmic|bcdedit|wbadmin|net1?|sc|taskkill|powershell|pwsh|cmd)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(delete shadows|shadowcopy delete|shadowcopy call delete|Win32_ShadowCopy|recoveryenabled No|bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures|wbadmin delete catalog|delete catalog -quiet|stop \"vss\"|stop veeam|stop MSSQL|stop SQLSERVERAGENT|BackupExecAgent|/im sqlservr\.exe|/im veeam|Memtas)", field=CommandLine)
| Tech := if(regex("(?i)(delete shadows|shadowcopy delete|shadowcopy call delete|Win32_ShadowCopy)", field=CommandLine), then="vss_wipe", else=if(regex("(?i)(recoveryenabled No|bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures|wbadmin delete catalog)", field=CommandLine), then="recovery_disable", else="backup_kill"))
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, bucket(span=10m, field=@timestamp)], function=[count(), collect([Tech, CommandLine, ImageFileName, ParentBaseFileName], multival=true), min(@timestamp, as=FirstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=LastSeen)])
| TechCount := length(splitstring(Tech, by=","))
| TechCount >= 2
ucs.rationale: Microsoft Threat Intelligence, Mandiant, and CrowdStrike reporting on ALPHV/BlackCat/Noberus all document the same compact sabotage triad executed seconds-to-minutes before encryption: VSS wipe via vssadmin/wmic, recovery disable via bcdedit + wbadmin, and a Veeam/MSSQL/BackupExec/Memtas service-kill sweep — frequently launched concurrently on a fleet of hosts via PsExec from a compromised DC.
